title: The Painted Smiles
text: The faceless here have painted smiles on their blank faces, wide red smiles in thick greasepaint. They smile at you, all of them, all the time, from doorways and windows and rooftops. Their smiles are cracking at the edges.

options.label: Smile back at them, and hope you smile the way they do.

outcomes.text: They are delighted, and give you gifts, and keep smiling.
Your smile is wrong somehow, and every painted smile drops at once.

options.label: The shrewdest paints a smile on their own face, to pass for one of them.

outcomes.text: They take them for one of their own and lead you out. The paint is hard to wash off.

options.label: Hurry past the smiling faces, and do not meet their eyes.

outcomes.text: The smiles follow you, from every window, until long after there are no more windows.
